spec.moment: Building a sandcastle with a moat and seaweed flag at the beach with little brother.

elements.name: sandcastle
elements.look: a sculpted sand fortress with turrets, surrounded by a shallow water-filled moat and topped with a dark green seaweed ribbon flag

elements.name: little brother
elements.look: a small boy in blue shorts and a bright yellow sunhat kneeling in the damp sand

elements.name: older sibling
elements.look: a taller figure in a striped tee and rolled-up shorts holding a small plastic bucket

elements.name: beach toys
elements.look: a red plastic spade and an overturned blue sand bucket

spec.scene: A patch of packed, damp tan sand sits center stage, glistening slightly from ocean spray. In the middle rises a detailed sandcastle with chunky square towers, encircled by a smooth trench of water, topped with a strand of dark green seaweed as a banner. At the left kneels a small child in blue shorts and a yellow hat, patting a wall. Beside the castle sits a taller figure in rolled-up shorts with a red plastic spade. At the back edge, a gentle turquoise wave laps softly onto the shore.
spec.title: Moats and Seaweed Flags
spec.caption: Built an entire fortress with my brother at Ocean Beach today.
